candidates.snippet: 1901: Joins the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party - Stalin joined the Bolshevik faction of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party, beginning his revolutionary career. 1902: Exiled to Siberia - Stalin was arrested and exiled to Siberia for his revolutionary activities, a common punishment for dissidents. 1922: Becomes General Secretary of the Communist Party - Stalin was appointed General Secretary of the Communist Party, a position that consolidated his power. 1945: Publishes 'Problems of Leninism' - Stalin published 'Problems of Leninism,' a key work outlining his political theories and solidifying his ideological stance.
